Research_Question_Description: How direct multi-horizon gradient boosting performs under decision-time causality across horizons h=1..7
Primary_Methodological_Layer: Decoupled Global Direct XGBoost (M1..M7) with Lag >= 7
Main_Empirical_Finding: Stable validation predictive accuracy across horizons (MAE 6.0285 to 6.0518; aggregate MAE 6.0388; RMSE 7.8638)
Operational_Generalization_Boundary: Evaluated on single 500-series retail benchmark; does not imply universal superiority over deep neural architectures

Research_Question_Description: How rolling forecast-conditional conformal calibration behaves under forward distribution shift
Main_Empirical_Finding: Empirical coverage degraded under shift (17.9% to 32.0% at 90% nominal); forecast conditioning improved Winkler loss and relative coverage but did not restore nominal coverage
Operational_Generalization_Boundary: Coverage guarantees require exchangeability; nominal confidence beta acts as an operational risk dial rather than guaranteed empirical coverage

Research_Question_Description: How converting conformal uncertainty margins into safety stock affects fill rate and lost sales across lead times L in {1;3;5;7}
Primary_Methodological_Layer: Continuous-Review Order-Up-To Policy (ROP = Dhat + SS) in Discrete-Event Sim
Main_Empirical_Finding: Demand-weighted fill rate improved by +7.29 to +10.64 pp (mean series delta +5.43 to +10.36 pp; 95% CI [+10.19; +10.55] at L=1); lost sales reduced by 20.0% to 29.6% (up to 1.14M units prevented; p < 10^-75)
Operational_Generalization_Boundary: Evaluated within controlled discrete-event simulation under lost sales without stochastic lead times or capacity limits

Research_Question_Description: How total operational costs behave across lead times and asymmetric shortage penalties p in {$0.60; $1; $2; $4}
Primary_Methodological_Layer: Financial Cost Model (Holding h=$0.20; Ordering K=$10; Shortage p)
Main_Empirical_Finding: At L=1 and p=$1.00; conformal replenishment lowered total simulated cost by 10.83% (-$790;834; p=6.65e-55); at L>=3; higher holding costs create a cost-service trade-off where conformal is cost-preferred when p >= $2.00
Operational_Generalization_Boundary: Cost trade-offs are derived from the evaluated discrete-event simulation parameters rather than proprietary enterprise accounting ledgers
